name: Kotone
source:
The angel of the school.
She is a neat, kind-hearted young lady from a prominent family. She is so popular that there is a fan club in the school.
She is not only a good student, but is also passionate about social service and does her best in volunteer activities.

Translated from http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1208226
